Effect: [When Digivolving] Activate 1 of the effects below.
・Choose any number of your opponent's Digimon so that their play cost total is up to 6 and return them to the bottom of the deck.
・1 of your other Digimon digivolves into a level 6 or lower Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name in your hand without paying the cost.
・This Digimon and one of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand for the cost.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Omnimon] in its name, return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
